Author: Kwuwa (based on PvP TopPlates by Petra105)
Name: Jarvis PvP
Description:
Draws clear plates for players in PvP above the 3D world: HP with barrier, MP and Limit Break bars, job icon, Guard with its recast, debuffs, sign markers and the enemies that have you as their target. Settings window with a live preview, four themes, diagnostics and English / French / German / Japanese texts.

Use /jpvp to open the settings. Based on PvP TopPlates by Petra105 (MIT licence).
Punchline: Clear PvP plates: HP, MP, Limit Break, Guard, debuffs, signs and who targets you.
Changelog: 1.0: first public release as Jarvis PvP. Settings window with sidebar pages, a live preview of you, your target and an ally, four themes, Test in world, Diagnostics with Copy report and Report a problem. Debuffs on enemies, allies and yourself, each with its own position. Plates stay above the game's UI and only hide behind plugin windows.
